//: lib is pinned to ES2023 with no DOM on purpose. TypeScript includes DOM by default when lib is unset, so until this line existed a Lambda could reference document or window and typecheck clean -- verified by planting document.title in src/lambda/capture.ts. This config covers the Lambdas, the CDK app and the Node scripts; JSX files are excluded here; components go to tsconfig.app.json and .tsx tests to tsconfig.test.json, and pnpm typecheck runs all three. A .ts file that imports a .tsx will fail here with TS6142 -- make it a .tsx test instead.
